items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The interviewee refers to 'Another Liza' as a performer ('she was the end girl in that show') whom they saw, but does not describe a personal relationship.

ctx.x: And by the time we got to Paris, she was as big as this room in Paris already. Mm-hmm. You know? Farley's Brigitte. Mm-hmm. And that's where we left her. She was the end girl in that show Liza. The end girl? Yeah. We went to see that show and we sailed the next day.
Was that George Gershwin's show, Liza?
